speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned an inability to flex the finger, but did you also experience an inability to actively extend the tip of the finger at the distal interphalangeal joint? I need to clarify if this is a mallet finger injury involving the extensor tendon.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the mechanism of injury and the inability to actively extend the fingertip, this presentation is classic for a mallet finger. I will now confirm the diagnosis with imaging. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_right_hand
